newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Shareholders approve creation of Sasani.
newsitem.headline: Shareholders approve creation of Sasani.

text.p: The creation of Sasani Ltd, a new firm which is to debut on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) through a reverse listing into the Crendell cash shell, has been given the go-ahead by shareholders.

The company said in a statement on Thursday shareholders approved the change of name of Crendell Investment Corp Ltd to Sasani and the acquisition by Crendell of the Video Lab Group business, which will form the core of the new business.
The name change will take effect next Monday when the listing will be transferred from the JSE's industrial-cash sector to the industrial-media sector.
The appointment of a number of directors was also approved. These include Nic Frangos as chairman and Welcome Msomi as chief executive.
